project_name: Budget Mitra / SERPL Industrial Login Portal

image_urls.description: Industrial plant refinery machinery engineering for split panel hero background

key_functionalities: Demo login form with prefilled or quick demo credentials
Employee No. input field with validation
Password field with show/hide visibility toggle
Secure Login action with success toasts and dashboard redirection
Responsive dual-panel layout (promotional brand showcase + clean authentication card)

accessibility.contrast_ratio: WCAG AA compliant (minimum 4.5:1 for normal text)
accessibility.aria_attributes: All form controls properly labeled with aria-describedby and data-testid attributes

universal_guidelines: Every interactive and key informational element MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Do not use complete transparent background on headers or overlays.
Generous padding and clean modern styling matching enterprise grade industrial portals.
